open_items: Corner Health: $32.5M is the combined seed + Series A total; Series A alone reported as $25M by other outlets (not fetched). Wischoff's role in seed vs Series A not distinguished; recorded under the round announcement.
Fund III: Forbes Australia (dated 2024-10-21) says $50M raised; no close date. Fund II ($20M, TechCrunch 2022-12-16) is the lead's 2022 fund; the $50M is Fund III, not Fund II.
HQ (Nashville per Forbes; NYC office planned), stages, check size ($800K-$1.6M) come from fetch-tool summaries without quotable text; not recorded.
